defs.def: a company that provides regular flights to take passengers and goods to different places 航空公司

ex.s: One of the biggest companies I wrote to ____43____ (be) Alaska Airlines Paris.
ex.t: 我写信的最大公司之一是____43____（是/be）阿拉斯加航空公司巴黎。

ex.s: A company ____44____ (represent) wrote back and told me the airline was switching over _____45_____ plastic to paper cups on all of its 1,200 daily flights.
ex.t: 一家（第44空，represent）公司回信告诉我，该航空公司在它每天1200个航班上正从塑料杯（第45空）纸杯。

ex.s: Harbour Air is the largest seaplane airline in North America, flying 30,000 commercial flights in 40 seaplanes each year.
ex.t: 港湾航空是北美最大的水上飞机航空公司，每年用40架水上飞机执行30,000次商业航班。

ex.s: "As an airline, we're currently in the process of turning all our planes into electric airplanes,” says CEO Greg McDougall.
ex.t: “作为一家航空公司，我们目前正在把全部飞机改造成电动飞机，”首席执行官格雷格·麦克杜格尔说。

ex.s: To make this happen, the airline has partnered up with MagniX to create the world's first commercial flight with an electric engine.
ex.t: 为实现这一目标，该公司已与MagniX合作，创造世界上首次使用电动发动机的商业飞行。

ex.s: Inventors have been trying to make flying cars since the 1930s, according to Robert Mann, an airline industry expert.
ex.t: 据航空业专家罗伯特·曼所说，发明家们自20世纪30年代以来就一直试图制造飞行汽车。

ex.t: 他们没有一路乘坐商业航空公司，而是决定飞往温哥华，然后乘坐火车。
